{{Quote|A contact of mine mentioned that he was smug...er...shipping some rather odd items.|[[Ja'inn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" />}}
'''Moril''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" />

==Biography==
{{Quote| But he was visibly sweating, which is very odd. He's scared and in my experience, that's bad. Extremely bad.|Ja'inn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Moril operated on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and often worked for the [[Rogue CorSec]].<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he was hired to smuggle animal feed, chemicals and tranquilizer materials to an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]],<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMRM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Researching Manipulation|Corellia}}</ref> Moril was terrified by what he saw in the lab and later refused to discuss with anybody about that job. One of his contacts, [[Ja'inn]], once tried to ask him about that and Moril was not able to hide his terror, displaying a very strange behavior. Ja'inn was worried and therefore reported this discussion to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Joth thus sent a spacer to interrogate Moril. The Bothan agreed to give the details of his smuggling run, including the drop location for the shipment.<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> This would led to the discovery of the illegal lab by the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Moril was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Moril was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
